feature: larger SharedChannel read turn for 256-KiB messages

candidate.design: A separate max_read_bytes_per_turn option let the shared reader feed a 256-KiB ring region to the decoder in one turn while keeping the write turn at 64 KiB.

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; default, candidate, candidate, default
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

conclusion: A 256-KiB read turn did not reduce the persistent large-message cost; the extra ring region and larger feed hurt more than any direct-delivery benefit. The option and code changes were reverted.
